strategy.thesis: Single-family office of pharma entrepreneur Mori Arkin (co-founder of Agis Industries, sold to Perrigo for $818M in 2005) that deploys permanent, patient family capital exclusively into pharmaceuticals, biotechnology and medical devices through dedicated arms: Arkin Bio (private biotech), Arkin Digital Health (early-stage digital health) and Sphera Healthcare Hedge Funds (public biotech, pre-IPO to public).

strategy.thesis: Israeli private-equity affiliate of Claridge Inc., the Bronfman family's primary investment vehicle; deploys permanent capital directly from the family balance sheet (no external blind-pool LPs) into growth-stage Israeli tech companies, with digital health as one of its five core sectors alongside enterprise software, cybersecurity, fintech and advanced manufacturing.

summary.en: Herzliya-based Israeli affiliate of the Bronfman family's Claridge Inc. investment vehicle, deploying $20-50M growth-stage checks from permanent family capital into Israeli tech companies, including digital health alongside its other core sectors.
